name: Linear living
description: A narrow home with living and kitchen spaces beside a private and service band.
review: Bedroom and service band beside living/kitchen, with entrance and rear terrace. Original sauna is simplified to storage; dimensions and extra rooms are project adaptations.

name: Split living
description: Distinct living and kitchen zones with bedrooms distributed into separate private wings.
review: Diagonal bedrooms and separate kitchen/living around an offset entry. Stepped boundary and side terrace are retained; dimensions and extra rooms are project adaptations.

name: Wide family residence
description: A central living and dining spine, a service wing, and a separate bedroom wing.
review: Manually reviewed spatial arrangement, including the garage/service wing. Porch, sauna and original dimensions are not copied; optional suites and extra rooms are project adaptations.
